template_base: templates/dark-v2/index.html (Pure Artistry dark exemplar, re-palette from gold to electric blue)
template_base_note: PIPELINE.md and the task brief both reference templates/dark or templates/light (no -v2 suffix) as the exemplar, but those two files contain ZERO data-es/data-en bilingual markup and predate the current bilingual requirement in DESIGN.md. templates/dark-v2 and templates/light-v2 are the current frozen, fully-bilingual skeletons described in templates/SKELETONS-V2.md as 'the proven method' for recent builds, and they are the only ones that satisfy scripts/gate.py's current checks (data-es markers, the per-site-isolated `siteforge:lang:` localStorage key, and the ban on bare `navigator.language` / global `localStorage.getItem('lang')`). dark-v2 was chosen over light-v2 because the business's own marketing site uses a dark navy background with an electric-blue accent (#1fa9ff) plus amber highlights, which maps naturally onto a dark base with the accent re-tinted to electric blue; all copy, services, reviews, images and contact data are 100% specific to this business.
build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5 / DESIGN.md: no exact per-service pricing (free estimate / call for quote, which is the business's real advertised standard), CTA to phone call / SMS / email instead of online booking, real street address so a real Google Maps embed was used (no substitute photo needed), 4 real Google-review testimonials with full names.
palette: Electric blue on near-black navy: bg #0a0f14, bg-2 #111a23, ink #edf5fb, accent-deep #1f9eea, accent-mid #4fb6ea, accent-soft #0f202c. merktop-badge kept its protected gold/amber per DESIGN.md rule (never re-palette the badge).
